title: Warm Polish Rye Crumble Bread
description: A delicious combination of warm spices and polish flavors in a rye crumble bread, perfect for a chilly day.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine rye flour, polish warm spice mix, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and water.
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased loaf pan.
Mix crumble topping and sprinkle over the dough.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
